# OSS Security KB Maintenance — Proposed Updates

---

## 1. PyPI `h11`

### Page: Add or Update `h11` entry

**Latest version:** 0.16.0
**Source:** [github.com/python-hyper/h11](https://github.com/python-hyper/h11)
**Summary:** Pure-Python HTTP/1.1 implementation (bring-your-own-I/O)

### Vulnerability Row to Add/Update

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **CVE** | CVE-2025-43859 |
| **Advisory** | GHSA-vqfr-h8mv-ghfj |
| **Summary** | h11 accepts some malformed Chunked-Encoding bodies, potentially enabling HTTP request smuggling |
| **Affected** | All versions < 0.16.0 |
| **Fixed in** | 0.16.0 |
| **Fix commit** | [114803a](https://github.com/python-hyper/h11/commit/114803a29ce50116dc47951c690ad4892b1a36ed) |
| **References** | [Advisory](https://github.com/python-hyper/h11/security/advisories/GHSA-vqfr-h8mv-ghfj), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-43859) |

### Posture Note

> **h11 is a transitive dependency of popular frameworks (e.g., uvicorn, httpcore).** Projects using h11 < 0.16.0 should upgrade promptly. The malformed chunked-encoding parsing flaw can facilitate request smuggling when h11 sits behind or alongside a proxy with different parsing behavior. Only 1 known CVE to date; the project's overall vulnerability history is minimal.

---

## 2. Maven `org.apache.httpcomponents.client5:httpclient5`

### Page: Add or Update `httpclient5` entry

**Latest version:** 5.6.1
**Source:** [github.com/apache/httpcomponents-client](https://github.com/apache/httpcomponents-client)

### Vulnerability Row 1 — Add/Update

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **CVE** | CVE-2025-27820 |
| **Advisory** | GHSA-73m2-qfq3-56cx |
| **Summary** | Apache HttpClient disables TLS domain/certificate hostname checks in versions 5.4-alpha1 through 5.4.2 |
| **Affected** | 5.4-alpha1 ≤ version < 5.4.3 |
| **Fixed in** | 5.4.3 |
| **References** | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-27820), [Apache mailing list](https://lists.apache.org/thread/55xhs40ncqv97qvoocok44995xp5kqn8), [PR #574](https://github.com/apache/httpcomponents-client/pull/574), [PR #621](https://github.com/apache/httpcomponents-client/pull/621), [NetApp advisory](https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20250516-0003) |

### Vulnerability Row 2 — Add/Update

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **CVE** | CVE-2026-40542 |
| **Advisory** | GHSA-v468-qcjx-r72w |
| **Summary** | Apache HttpClient accepts SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication without proper mutual authentication verification |
| **Affected** | 5.6-alpha1 ≤ version < 5.6.1 |
| **Fixed in** | 5.6.1 |
| **Fix commit** | [726eac2](https://github.com/apache/httpcomponents-client/commit/726eac2323d370435d8afca1e0540aa099927f18) |
| **References** | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40542), [Apache mailing list](https://lists.apache.org/thread/tfmgv86xr0z1y096vs3z0y315t1v3o97), [oss-security](http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/04/22/5) |

### Posture Note

> **Both CVEs affect only relatively recent version ranges** (5.4.x alpha–5.4.2 and 5.6.x alpha–5.6.0 respectively). Users on the stable 5.3.x line or earlier are **not affected** by either vulnerability based on published range data. CVE-2025-27820 (disabled domain checks) is particularly high-impact for TLS security and should be prioritized. CVE-2026-40542 affects only users who explicitly opted into SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication (available from 5.6-alpha1 onward). Upgrade to at least 5.4.3 (for 5.4.x users) or 5.6.1 (for 5.6.x users).

### ⚠️ Caution on CVE-2026-40542

> The CVE identifier `CVE-2026-40542` carries a 2026-year prefix, which is unusual. The advisory metadata references an April 2026 disclosure date. **Verify this CVE's authenticity against NVD and the Apache security mailing list** before marking it as confirmed. It may represent a future/embargoed entry or a data anomaly.

---

## 3. Go `github.com/gorilla/mux`

### What NOT to Change

- **No new vulnerability rows.** OSV returns 0 vulnerabilities for `gorilla/mux`. There is no public evidence of any unpatched CVE.
- **Do not remove or downgrade** any existing KB page for gorilla/mux.

### Posture Note (Update if not already present)

> **gorilla/mux has zero known CVEs** per current OSV data. However, note that the Gorilla toolkit was [archived in December 2022 and later adopted by new maintainers in 2023](https://github.com/gorilla/mux). KB consumers should verify the project's current maintenance status. The absence of CVEs reflects either strong security posture or low auditing attention — **this is not a guarantee of zero risk**, especially for a widely-used HTTP router that processes untrusted input.

---

## Summary of Actions

| Target | Action | Details |
|---|---|---|
| **h11** | Add/Update page + 1 vuln row | CVE-2025-43859; fixed in 0.16.0 |
| **httpclient5** | Add/Update page + 2 vuln rows | CVE-2025-27820 (fixed 5.4.3), CVE-2026-40542 (fixed 5.6.1) |
| **gorilla/mux** | No vulnerability changes | 0 CVEs found; add/update maintenance-status posture note only |

### Do NOT Change

- **gorilla/mux vulnerability table** — no evidence supports adding any CVE.
- **httpclient5 versions ≤ 5.
